train_model: train a sequence-to-sequence model for one epoch using an iterator, optimizer, and gradient clipping
evaluate_model: evaluate a trained model on a validation iterator and return loss per word and accuracy
cal_loss: calculate cross entropy loss with optional label smoothing for sequence prediction tasks
cal_performance: compute loss, number of correct predictions, and total word count for model performance metrics
tokenize_de: tokenize German text into a reversed list of tokens using spaCy for machine translation
